ExplanationParts.CorpusEarnedOpening: Sudhana is the repeatedly travelling visitor invoked from his meetings with many guides.
EvidenceBody: Chan speakers address Sudhana, cite his sequence of meetings, compare seekers with him, and ask what he obtained. The figure is defined here by those Zen questions and comparisons, not by a complete outside biography.

DraftEvidence.ZenBend: Zen turns Sudhana’s many visits into public questions about seeking, meeting, and recognition.
DraftEvidence.CounterexampleOrLimit: Narration, direct address, and comparisons by later speakers remain distinct and are not all assigned to Shangu Chonghui.
